integrity: The counterexample and repair are exact operator identities. No numerical experiment is used as proof, and no claim of independent validation is made.
scientific_limitations: The counterexample is in the scalar Hilbert-space specialization, which is sufficient to falsify the module theorem but does not classify every possible noncommutative repair.
Replacing isometry by co-isometry is proved sufficient under the remaining hypotheses; necessity is asserted only for the specialization \(C=K=I\) within the class of isometries.
title: An isometry/co-isometry reversal in a controlled \(K\)-frame invariance theorem
